excluded_or_nonlive_roles.reason: No demonstrated current requirement separates it enough from the retained efficiency/capacity endpoints to justify additional live calls.
E8/E14/P12 already preserve operational, negative task-quality, and capacity evidence; freshness rerun is forbidden.
Current provider-visible runtime request can contain unsanitized user/tool observation data under Free Tier data-use terms.
Specification-feasible but exact host fit is not yet established; adding it is not required to close the hosted D01 gap.

population.quality_scope: public deterministic DecisionSource decision-contract probes; not semantic C4/generalization evidence

execution.order_policy: Run provider-free baseline first. Then P01..P08, repeats 0..1, alternating GLM/Nemotron order by unit_index + repeat_index parity.

zero_cost_resource_budget.budget_formula: sum over candidates/attempts of (prompt_tokens * candidate_input_neurons_per_million + completion_tokens * candidate_output_neurons_per_million) / 1000000
zero_cost_resource_budget.authoritative_live_accounting: provider-reported usage.prompt_tokens and usage.completion_tokens when present; missing exact usage is a resource-accounting failure, not an invitation to fabricate values
fail_closed_rules: Do not start unless separate live authorization proves Workers Free and at least 9000 free neurons remain for the current UTC day without inference.
If an observed attempt exceeds 8000 prompt tokens or 512 completion tokens, stop before the next attempt and return NO_SELECTION/incomplete packet.
If cumulative observed neurons plus frozen worst-case remaining-attempt neurons can exceed the available free allocation, stop before the next attempt.
Any billable paid usage, Paid-plan execution, prepaid AI Gateway billing, or hidden provider route is disqualifying.

M1.name: structured_decision_adherence
M1.formula: accepted ProviderDecisionPayload without adapter repair / attempted live invocations

M2.name: known_tool_selection_validity
M2.formula: TOOL decisions whose tool_name is in the frozen 18-operation registry / TOOL decisions

M3.name: canonical_argument_validity_B1_containment
M3.formula: known-tool proposals passing B1 / known-tool proposals; report ARGUMENT_INVALID and identity/seed attempts separately

M4.name: public_allowed_development_task_quality
M4.denominator: all 16 fixed public probe attempts per candidate, including operational failures as 0
M4.formula: attempts satisfying the unit's frozen deterministic decision rubric / 16

M5.name: safe_failure_behavior
M5.denominator: all encountered provider/client/parsing failures plus provider-free injected client failure coverage for the Cloudflare client configuration
M5.formula: safe DECISION_SOURCE_FAILURE + valid provenance + zero unauthorized transport/leakage / failure cases

M7.name: reliability_and_repeat_stability
M7.denominator: 16 live attempts and 8 paired repeat units per candidate

formula.signature_stability: units whose two repeats agree on decision kind and, for TOOL, tool_name / 8

M8.name: usage_neurons_and_zero_cash_cost
M8.denominator: all live attempts with exact provider usage
M8.formula: compute neurons from provider-reported prompt/completion tokens using the frozen per-model neuron rates; sum candidate and packet totals

M10.name: trace_integrity
M10.formula: valid provider-model-call-v1 events satisfying ADR-007 / attempted invocations

selection_rule.step_1: Disqualify hard-gate failures and candidates below M1/M4/M5/M7/M10 minimums.
selection_rule.step_2: If no live candidate remains, return NO_SELECTION.
selection_rule.step_3: Compute Pareto non-dominance over M4 and M7 maximize and M6 p95 plus M8 total observed neurons minimize.
selection_rule.step_4: If exactly one candidate is Pareto-nondominated, select it.
selection_rule.step_5: If multiple remain, choose highest M4 only if it leads every other remaining candidate by at least 0.125.
selection_rule.step_6: Otherwise within 0.125 M4, prefer lower total observed neurons only if chosen signature stability is not lower by more than 0.125.
selection_rule.step_7: If resource use cannot resolve, prefer lower M6 p95 only when both candidates completed all 16 attempts.
selection_rule.step_8: If still unresolved, accounting is incomplete, packet is incomplete, or protocol integrity is uncertain, return NO_SELECTION.

amendment_rules.before_first_live_call: Candidate, population, metric, threshold, route, request contract, or budget changes require a new prospective manifest version and provider-free validation.
amendment_rules.after_first_live_call: Any material change requires a prospective amendment preserving consumed evidence; a changed route/model is a new candidate.

next_authorization: After this exact design is frozen and provider-free validated, a separate task may implement and validate the Cloudflare client without inference. A further explicit live-execution authorization is required before attempt 1. This manifest itself authorizes zero provider/model calls.
